thread:
jess_sales: FYI — Prospect "Aurea Therapeutics" dropped a 170-question vendor security spreadsheet into our portal. Deadline "next Friday" per their AE. Main asks: data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, incident response timelines. Link: https://aurea.vendors/doc/qa-2026.xlsx
liam_ae: Thanks. This is a high-priority POC opportunity. Recommend we send a short-form Q&A within 48 hours, then the full SIG/CAIQ-aligned answers with attachments. Who can take the lead?
noah_sec: I can own the answers. Ill produce short-form first-pass (about 30 canonical answers) + mapping to SIG/CAIQ rows. Need evidence: SOC2 report, infra network diagram, KMS policies. @devon_se can you confirm KMS details and whether any customers have dedicated HSM?
devon_se: Confirmed: hosted customers use AWS KMS (CMKs) and envelope encryption; rotation policy set to annual by default. HSM-backed keys are only available for Private clusters on request. I can export key policy snippets and diagram. Will need access to their question CSV or I'll parse the XLSX.
rachel_sec_ops: Ill grab the latest SOC2 PDF, last pen-test executive summary, and retention policy docs. Also can produce an evidence index for each SIG control we reference. Estimate: evidence collation ~3 hrs.
jess_sales: Can we get an ETA for the first-pass answers? Customer cares about timeline so we can keep the pipeline warm.
noah_sec: First pass (short answers) by Wed EOD (roughly 2 business days). Full annotated pack with attachments by next Tue assuming they provide the questions as CSV. If they only give XLSX/PDF add 4-6 hrs.
liam_ae: I'll ask them for CSV export and confirm scope (prod only vs prod+staging). Also will check if they require encrypted backups in specific regions.
sec-bot: :information_source: Auto-note: Attach SOC2 report v2026-07 and pen-test summary v2025-11 to SECREQ-4129. Evidence storage: s3://sec-evidence/prospects/aurea/pack_v1
devon_se: Quick mapping Ill take: encryption & key mgmt, network segmentation, backing up & geo replication Qs. Noah you take auth, logging, incident response. Rachel handle policies + evidence index.
noah_sec: Also flagging any "requires dedicated deployment" answers — Ill mark those with the text: "(Dedicated/Private only)" so sales knows when this is a contractual ask.
jess_sales: Please list estimated hours so I can log on the opportunity and alert finance if > 20hrs.
rachel_sec_ops: Draft estimate: drafting answers 5-7 hrs, evidence gathering 3-5 hrs, review & annotations 2 hrs. Total ~10-14 hrs. Add 6-8 hrs if they want HSM artifacts or a dedicated runbook.
liam_ae: Good. Also ask whether they want CAIQ JSON + human-readable PDF. Some customers accept the JSON import.
devon_se: If they want CAIQ JSON I can map programmatically but need the CSV; I'll run a script to map answers to CAIQ fields. If not, manual mapping will add time.
jess_sales: Owner assignment: noah_sec primary, devon_se tech owner, rachel_sec_ops evidence & reviewer. I'll tag the opportunity as "security-intake: active" and follow up after I confirm CSV.
sec-bot: :white_check_mark: SECREQ-4129 created and assigned to noah_sec. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SECREQ-4129
liam_ae: I'll loop in legal if they want an NDA for the attachments. Also confirm whether Aurea requires redaction of any example logs.
noah_sec: Noted. If they request log samples we should send sanitized examples only. I'll prepare a sanitized log snippet template.
jess_sales: Thanks team. I'll update Aurea and paste their CSV here when I get it. Ping me if you need direct access to their portal to pull the file.
